redis_delta_post_freeze.total_keys_delta_explanation: Legacy volatile keys aged out via natural TTL after legacy writers stopped. No DEL, no UNLINK, no TRIM, no FLUSH was issued by this lane.
redis_delta_post_freeze.v2_star_keys_delta_explanation: V2 housekeeping (TTL expiry on transient v2 keys). V2 writers continue to refresh primary v2:* keys.

legacy_redis_writers_remaining_evidence: All 9 legacy ingestor processes exited (SIGTERM). Trader and feature pipeline exited. Hybrid trainer is sleeping post-SIGTERM and is not writing new Redis keys (state=S, no CPU). Trainer may flush a checkpoint on graceful exit but its writes target a separate checkpoint store, not legacy redis ingest namespaces.
natural_ttl_expiry_explanation: After legacy writers stopped, keys with TTL expired naturally. Keys without TTL remain preserved. Total drop of 863 over 8 minutes represents organic key expiry from frozen writer set.
